mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Common_Product ( PROD_CODE, SOURCE, CATEGORY, PROD_NAME, PROD_PRICE, TARGET_PRICE, CHECK_INTERVAL ) VALUES ( #{prodCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{source, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{category, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{price, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{targetPrice, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{checkInterval, jdbcType=INTEGER} )
mapper.select: SELECT PROD_ID as prodId, PROD_NAME as name, PROD_PRICE as price, TARGET_PRICE as targetPrice FROM Common_Product WHERE PROD_ID = #{prodId}
SELECT PRICE, TO_CHAR(REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as REG_DATE FROM PRICE_HISTORY WHERE PROD_ID = #{prodId} ORDER BY REG_DATE ASC
SELECT PROD_ID FROM Common_Product WHERE PROD_CODE = #{prodCode}
